## Pre-conditions (from react-migration)

The following are complete from the react-migration project and must not be broken:
- `packages/react` — React 18 component library, 242 tests pass
- `packages/site/content/` — 43 MDX docs files (migrated from Gatsby)
- `packages/site/content/api/` — 102 JSON prop files (generated by build/generate-api.ts)
- `packages/site/src/examples/` — 40+ React example `.tsx` files
